Today, in addition to releasing a major update for Final Cut Camera, Apple also announced upcoming updates for Pages, Keynote, Numbers, Pixelmator Pro, and Freeform. Below is an overview of each new feature.

Apple releases updates for its "Creator Studio" suite of apps, with new features available to non-subscribers as well

Today, Apple unveiled a host of new features for its popular iWork suite — Pages, Keynote, and Numbers — while also bringing improvements to Pixelmator Pro and Freeform.

Some of the new features are exclusive to Apple Creator Studio subscribers, but a selection is available to all users. Below is a summary of all the updates compiled from Apple Newsroom:

Pages, Keynote, Numbers

Apple says this update lets users ask Siri questions about Pages, Keynote, or Numbers and get answers. While it's not yet clear whether Apple Intelligence will be required, the possibility is high. The update also introduces the ability to request access to shared presentations, documents, or spreadsheets, making collaboration easier — owners no longer need to proactively enable sharing permissions.

Pages for Mac gains a brand-new "Screen View" mode that "streamlines content for reading and distraction-free writing." Numbers adds "trigonometry, statistics, and logic functions" to help users handle complex calculations in spreadsheets.

In addition, Apple Creator Studio subscribers can access new templates and themes across the three iWork apps. Keynote also introduces smart slide generation, automatically creating images tailored to the presentation's topic.

Pixelmator Pro

Pixelmator Pro for iPad picks up the "Select and Mask" tool, previously exclusive to the Mac edition. Both the Mac and iPad versions gain two new template collections centered on sports and motion themes, as well as new templates for "launching new creative ideas, businesses, or products."

On top of that, a new Podcast category has been added, making it easier for users to create cover artwork that meets the size requirements of major podcast platforms.

Freeform
